#+TITLE: Table export
#+AUTHOR: Test Author

* Header plus body rule
| Item  | Qty | Price |
|-------+-----+-------|
| Apple |   3 |  1.20 |
| Pear  |   1 |  0.80 |
|-------+-----+-------|
| Total |   4 |  2.00 |

* Fully ruled, top border first
|-------+-----|
| Item  | Qty |
|-------+-----|
| Apple |   3 |
|-------+-----|

* No rules at all
| Apple | 3 |
| Pear  | 1 |

* Rule below the second row
Org treats everything before the first rule as the header, the same way
=ox-latex= and =ox-html= do, so both rows above the rule end up in
=table.header=.

| Apple | 3 |
| Pear  | 1 |
|-------+---|
| Total | 4 |

* Consecutive rules collapse
| Item  | Qty |
|-------+-----|
|-------+-----|
| Apple |   3 |

* Caption and name become a figure
#+CAPTION: Quarterly fruit sales
#+NAME: tbl-fruit
| Item  | Qty |
|-------+-----|
| Apple |   3 |
| Pear  |   1 |

See [[tbl-fruit]].

* Caption with markup
#+CAPTION: Sales for /Q1/, *revised*
| Item  | Qty |
|-------+-----|
| Apple |   3 |

* Name alone is still wrapped, so it can be referenced
#+NAME: tbl-bare
| Item  | Qty |
|-------+-----|
| Apple |   3 |

Cross-reference: [[tbl-bare]].

* ATTR_TYPST overrides the defaults
#+ATTR_TYPST: :stroke 1pt :column-gutter 1em
| Item  | Qty |
|-------+-----|
| Apple |   3 |

* Alignment cookies
| <r>   |  <c> | <l>  |
| right | ctr  | left |
|-------+------+------|
| a     | b    | c    |
